name: Mimemind
source:
Mimemind is one of the employees at the Ghoul's Grove as a mime. He is very animated, dramatic, silly and strong, often showing off his strength in bizarre and humorous ways. Not once does he speak a word or make a noise.

He has black cat ears and a black and white tail that seems to set off Darcy's allergies. There is a blood-stained bandage over his throat and more on the sides of his head where his human ears would be, but despite this, he seems to be able to hear well.
